name: Peruvian taxes on construction (IGV, detraccion, retencion)
name_es: Impuestos peruanos en la construccion (IGV, detraccion, retencion)
standard: TUO de la Ley del IGV; Decreto Legislativo 940; Resolucion de Superintendencia 183-2004/SUNAT; Resolucion de Superintendencia 037-2002/SUNAT
review_status: unconfirmed. Drawn from the published legislation. Pending review by a Peruvian accountant.
scope_note: IGV applies to every bill. The detraccion applies to construction invoices above the SUNAT threshold; the retencion applies only to buyers SUNAT has designated.
description: IGV is 18 percent: 16 percent IGV plus 2 percent Impuesto de Promocion Municipal. A construction invoice carries the detraccion at 4 percent of the total, deposited to the supplier's account at the national bank (service code 030, threshold 700 soles). A designated buyer withholds 3 percent as retencion del IGV. The figures live in the payment taxes table and the validation rule set peru.
